meta.name: Shōsai design tokens
meta.role: The single tracked design-token source consumed by the Iced application (crates/shosai-app/src/theme_tokens.rs) and the Flutter frontend (flutter/lib/theme_tokens.dart). Generated and checked by scripts/generate-theme-tokens.py; neither generated file may be edited by hand.
meta.reference_subject: main@origin #108 (refactor(flutter): organize the frontend into Elm modules mirroring Iced)

authority.app.dark: Retained Flutter: Iced defines no dark application palette. The values are the shadcn_ui 0.56.3 'stone' dark scheme this application already rendered with, frozen here so the dark theme is mapped from tokens instead of a package default.
authority.reader.selection: Retained Flutter: RFD 6 selection/highlighting has no Iced reference (plan decision 8); the values are the colors this application already painted with.
authority.reader.annotation: Retained Flutter: annotation highlight colors have no Iced reference; the values are the colors this application already painted with.
authority.layout.library.card: Iced (crates/shosai-app/src/app.rs render_book_card and crates/shosai-app/src/widgets.rs book_button, the pinned reference)
authority.layout.library.card.placeholderPadding: Retained Flutter: the pinned Iced placeholder centres its label with no inset; this inset keeps a long or scaled label's ink inside the placeholder box.
authority.layout.library.card.triggerScrimAlpha: Retained Flutter: owner-directed refinement of the pinned card trigger (2026-09-25). Iced paints the trigger as an opaque SURFACE square with a 1 px BORDER (theme.rs book_card_action); the owner asked for a subtler trigger, so the reference's painted geometry keeps its 13 px glyph, [5, 8] padding and radiusSmall but is filled with this translucent ink scrim (app.shadow.base) under a light glyph (app.textOnAccent) instead.
authority.layout.library.card.triggerScrimActiveAl: Retained Flutter: the same refinement's hovered, pressed and open-menu weight of the trigger scrim; the reference's own hover only swaps SURFACE for SURFACE_MUTED.
authority.layout.readerChrome: Iced (crates/shosai-app/src/app.rs reader chrome, the pinned reference)
authority.layout.library.skeleton: Iced (crates/shosai-app/src/app.rs library_refresh_placeholder and render_loading_book_card, the pinned reference)
authority.layout.library.emptyState: Iced (crates/shosai-app/src/app.rs library_collection's empty composition, the pinned reference)
authority.layout.library.alertPadding: Iced (crates/shosai-app/src/app.rs library_collection's failure alert padding [7, 14], the pinned reference)
authority.layout.library.continueSectionTrailingSp: Iced (crates/shosai-app/src/app.rs library_collection's Space between the continue card and the next section, the pinned reference)

notes: Plan decision 2: Iced supplies the design values, including the accent #4D5E86; the historical #109 brown accent (#8A6338) is rejected and must not reappear.
Interface fonts and document fonts are separate: type.family.ui.* is interface chrome only, while EPUB book text keeps the document font or the reader preference.

Reader palettes are the document/page palettes (spec 3.3). Reader chrome uses the application palette for the light reader and the reader palette family for the dark and sepia readers, which Iced does not define.

app.textOnAccent, app.coverPlaceholder.background, app.shadow.hairline and reader.codeBlock.fallbackBackground are transcribed from the pinned Iced sources so that no literal theme color remains in the application modules; the reference specification's token tables name the styles they cover and are not extended by these entries.

layout.library.card.* and layout.library.collectionPadding* are transcribed from the pinned Iced library collection (app.rs render_book_card, widgets.rs book_button and app.rs library_collection). The specification's 3.5 table names the grid metrics and its prose names the collection padding [22, 24]; the card's internal metrics are recorded here so the Flutter card and the Iced card cannot drift. The pinned Iced card still writes these values literally in app.rs; migrating the Rust side is not part of this entry.

layout.continueCard.*, layout.library.skeleton.*, layout.library.emptyState.*, layout.library.sectionSpacing, layout.library.alertPadding* and layout.library.continueSectionTrailingSpace are transcribed from the same pinned library collection (app.rs render_continue_card, library_refresh_placeholder, render_loading_book_card and library_collection) for package 3C. The pinned Iced app still writes them literally; migrating the Rust side is not part of this entry.

layout.readerChrome.* is transcribed from the pinned Iced reader chrome (app.rs reader_header, tabs_view, status_bar, edge navigation, opening_document and the reader alert) for package 4B, which owns the reader presentation and asked for these entries through 3C, the token source's owner at the time. The pinned Iced app still writes them literally; migrating the Rust side is not part of this entry.
